item.title: Every Call Leaves a Trail - Extracting IP Addresses and Locations from WhatsApp Calls
item.description: How the STUN protocol and WebRTC expose a caller's real IP address during WhatsApp calls, and how a tool can capture STUN packets to extract and geolocate the other participant's IP in real time.
